description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginRequest" name="Login request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginConfirmation" name="Login confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompletedSelection" name="Completed product selection"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderReady" name="Address and payment steps completed"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EShop" name="E-Shop system" processRef="Process_EShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginRequest" name="Login request" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Start_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginConfirmation" name="Login confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginConfirmation" targetRef="Catch_LoginConfirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompletedSelection" name="Completed product selection" sourceRef="Task_SubmitSelection" targetRef="Start_CompletedSelection" messageRef="Message_CompletedSelection"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentData" name="Payment data" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Participant_Bank" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderReady" name="Address and payment steps completed" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOrderReady" targetRef="Catch_OrderReady" messageRef="Message_OrderReady"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Online shop ordering" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Customer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Customer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Login</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_LoginConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_LoginSuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ShoppingStopped</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddToCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SaveProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckProducts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AllProductsSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitSelection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterPaymentData</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PaymentAndAddressSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_PaymentConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterShippingAddress</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingAddressDifferent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterBillingAddress</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingAddressMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PaymentAndAddressJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyOrderReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_CustomerOrderStepsComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Begin shopping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in to the E-Shop"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_LoginConfirmation" name="Wait for login confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginConfirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" name="Login successful?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping stopped"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select a product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckProducts" name="Check whether every product has been selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" name="All products selected?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitSelection" name="Submit completed product selection to E-Shop"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressSplit" name="Wait for payment confirmation while entering address" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentConfirmation" name="Wait for bank payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressDifferent" name="Shipping address differs from billing address?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter independent billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge" name="Merge billing address paths" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressJoin" name="Payment confirmed and address entered" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NotifyOrderReady" name="Notify E-Shop that address and payment steps are complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerOrderStepsComplete" name="Address and payment steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_01" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_02" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Catch_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_03" sourceRef="Catch_LoginConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginSuccess" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginFailure" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="End_ShoppingStopped">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${not loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_04" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_05" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_06" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_07" sourceRef="Task_CheckProducts" targetRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreProducts" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${not allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductsComplete" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SubmitSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_08" sourceRef="Task_SubmitSelection" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_09" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressSplit" targetRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_11" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_12" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_13" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDifferent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingDifferent" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDifferent" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${shippingAddressDifferentFromBillingAddress}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingSame" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDifferent" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${not shippingAddressDifferentFromBillingAddress}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_14" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_15" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_16" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAndAddressJoin" targetRef="Task_NotifyOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_17" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOrderReady" targetRef="End_CustomerOrderStepsComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShop" name="E-Shop system workflow" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_EShop">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_EShop" name="E-Shop system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_LoginRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCredentials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendLoginConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_LoginHandled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_CompletedSelection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PreparePayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_OrderReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinishOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LoginRequest" name="Receive login request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check customer credentials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendLoginConfirmation" name="Send login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginHandled" name="Login confirmation sent"/>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CompletedSelection" name="Receive completed product selection">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CompletedSelection" messageRef="Message_CompletedSelection"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment for order"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment for order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Payment and shipment prepared" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_OrderReady" name="Wait for address and payment steps">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderReady" messageRef="Message_OrderReady"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderFinished" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_01" sourceRef="Start_LoginRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_02" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Task_SendLoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_03" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginConfirmation" targetRef="End_LoginHandled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_04" sourceRef="Start_CompletedSelection" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_05" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_06" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_07" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_08" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_09" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Catch_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_10" sourceRef="Catch_OrderReady" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EShop_11" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="End_OrderFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
